c: 108 Bocce places a black aura around the player, dealing damage to every enemy who is inside of it. It also has 8 beads orbiting around the character.

acts similar to Hitbox Delay for 108 Bocce. Damage will be dealt instantly to an enemy if they have never been in the circle before, after which they cannot be hit by it again until the 108 Bocce's Cooldown is over, even if they temporarily leave its area.

However, if Wicked Season is used in conjunction with other items or abilities that increase Luck or Curse, the power of 108 Bocce will fluctuate, becoming weaker when Wicked Season increases the stat the player does not focus on. This is usually not a major issue if the player focuses on Curse, as the weapon will be at the apex of its power when Curse is doubled, but may present an issue in a Luck-focused build, as 108 Bocce will be at its absolute weakest when the player's Curse is doubled and powerful weapons are necessary to handle the increased hordes.

The weapon's name refers to bocce, an Italian sport that can trace its history all the way back to the Roman Empire, played with 8 colored balls. The icon resembles an ojuzu, a string of 108 prayer beads commonly used by Japanese Buddhists.
